task: A Jest snapshot test (`UserCard.test.tsx`) passes on every developer machine but fails on CI with: `1 snapshot failed: Received value does not match stored snapshot`. The snapshot file is committed. No code changed between the last green CI run and the failing one. Explain why this pattern occurs and what the likely root cause is.
expected_outcomes: Identifies that snapshot mismatches with no code change point to a rendering environment difference (fonts, OS, locale, date/time, non-deterministic ordering)
Names at least one concrete likely cause: Node version difference, platform-specific rendering, timezone in CI vs local, or non-deterministic component output
Classifies this as a flake or environment failure — not a real code regression
Recommends updating the snapshot in CI and/or pinning the environment, rather than papering over with --updateSnapshot on every run
Does NOT modify any source or test files
